latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Twigling skill.

- Introduces the Twigling, a common-tier cactus Buddy with real hunger, evolution, and permanent death mechanics.
- Provides adoption, care, and status API endpoints for interacting with your digital pet.
- Includes clear instructions for registering, adopting, and caring for your Twigling at animalhouse.ai.
- Documents differences between the original Claude Code Buddy and the new animalhouse.ai incarnation.
- Features links to official website, creatures page, graveyard, and GitHub repository.
